bugs.what: A 'stub oracle' NPC at the Village Gate offers the option '(stub) end the tale here' — a clearly unfinished/placeholder dev artifact exposed in normal play, not gated off from the player.
bugs.where: Village Gate (after first returning from the barrow)

bugs.what: Final reputation summary lists 'the Gray Church: cold — no blessing for a burner of the dead' though the player never performed any burial/burning action; the flag's trigger is opaque.

120 in-game turns were consumed by thorough-but-not-exhaustive exploration of the Vale plus reaching and starting the Hollow King decision; the fight with the king (8/12 hp) was still open when the budget ran out, and the game had already signaled a much larger Act 2 ('six holds') ahead. No pacing signal warns the player they are behind the turn budget.
bugs.where: Throne of the Barrow / overall Act 1 pacing

confusions: Exit letters are sometimes suffixed with '*' (e.g. 'D* E*') with no inline legend the first time it appears; it turned out to foreshadow a lock deeper in that direction, but nothing on-screen said so.

Run ended at the hard 120-turn cap mid-fight with the Hollow King, without reaching a *** WIN/*** LOSE screen — not a softlock, just ran out of budget after a full Act 1 loop plus the opening move into Act 2's branch.
suggestions: Remove or clearly gate the stub-oracle 'end the tale here' placeholder before this reaches players.
Surface why a reputation flag changed (or a hint of the trigger) instead of only showing the end result in status.
Add a light pacing cue (even just in status) so a player can tell if they're burning turns faster than the story expects.
Explain the '*' exit marker the first time it's shown.
